newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle prices up $3-$4 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle prices up $3-$4 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were $3.00-$4.00 per cwt higher, with the most advance on lighter weights, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 10 percent cows and bulls, 30 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs. Receipts - 998 Last Week - 557 Last Year - 1,724
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 70.25-79.50; pkg 725 lbs 73.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-700 lbs 59.00-68.50; few 725-825 lbs 55.25-65.00.
